I build products that help teams make better decisions with data — analytics platforms, experimentation systems, and the workflows and teams that make them work in practice.

Right now that means working on a small set of [planned projects](projects.qmd), writing about [product leadership and analytics](writing.qmd), and building this site out in the open as I go.

## What I focus on {.eyebrow-heading}

::: {.focus-grid}
::: {.focus-card}
### Product leadership

Setting direction for technical products, defining what "better" means with metrics, and keeping engineering, data, and business teams pointed at the same problem.
:::

::: {.focus-card}
### Data & analytics

Turning messy data into decisions: measurement design, trustworthy metrics, self-serve tooling, and the unglamorous work that makes numbers believable.
:::

::: {.focus-card}
### Optimization & experimentation

Running trustworthy experiments: proper power analysis, honest guardrails, and building the cadence that turns A/B tests into a real learning system.
:::
:::
